output.headline: Dental strategics Heartland and Aspen plus provider-focused sponsors form the buyer universe for this Southeast dental target; upper-quartile pricing is defensible, though only the strategics clearly afford it.
sentences: Call Heartland Dental and Aspen Dental first: both have closed larger deals in this sub-sector; the seven sponsors are close to a tie (back-tests 28% versus 20% random) [E:tier1, E:sponsor_ordering]
Upper-quartile pricing at 15.4x EBITDA is defensible on the 18.0% margin; Heartland and Aspen can pay it, while sponsors reach only a 14.0% return at the ask against a 20% target [E:valuation, E:lbo]

The review removed or merged no one; Veritas Capital, Vista Equity and Francisco Partners stay in Tier 2 as technology investors, so confirm their appetite for tech-enabled services before outreach [E:review, E:tier2]
Most buyers share a geographic expansion motive, seen in 90% of 284 provider deals, so pitch the Southeast footprint first [E:motives]
